english.title: Fail to present control documents and operators licence for international special regular bus operations when required
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) operated an international special regular passenger service, namely **(..DESCRIBE SERVICE..), using a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY MAKE AND REG..), and failed to present, at the request of an authorised officer, the authorisation, or a certified true copy thereof, to carry out international special regular services, the operator's licence, or a certified true copy thereof, for the international carriage of passengers by road and the contract, or a copy thereof, between the organiser and the transport operator including evidence that the passengers constitute a specific category, in breach of Article 15 of the RSR Protocol
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 16(1)(b) and 18 of the Road Transport (International Passenger Services) Regulations 2018.
